root_cause: The drawer does not move focus to its content when opened, leaving focus on the triggering button or body, preventing keyboard users from interacting with filters.
repair_strategy: Override the show method in the Drawer class to focus the first focusable element (respecting autofocus) after the dialog is shown.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus will be moved into the drawer when opened, allowing keyboard users to tab to the close button, checkboxes, and apply button without needing a pointer.
functional_risks: If the drawer already defines an autofocus attribute, our logic will respect it by selecting that element first.
If no focusable elements exist inside the drawer, focus will be set on the drawer itself, which is harmless.
Potential minor overhead from the selector lookup, but negligible.
verification_requirements: After opening the drawer with Enter, focus should be on the first focusable element (e.g., #filters-close).
Subsequent Tab presses should move focus to the In stock checkbox, then Waterproof checkbox, then Apply button.
Escape key should close the drawer and return focus to the Filters toggle button.
Mouse interactions should continue to work as before.
The drawer should still be closable via the close button and backdrop click.
